definitions.explanation: Foods eaten alongside the staple food (typically rice in Japan). Includes dishes such as fish, meat, vegetables, pickles, and soup that accompany the main grain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副食品|ふくしょくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The side dishes in the school lunch are excellent.

examples.japanese: {副食品|ふくしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The prices of side dish items are going up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧、⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{副食品|ふくしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to combine staple foods with side dishes while considering nutritional balance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (supplementary, secondary) + ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (food items). In traditional Japanese meal structure, food is divided into ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧ (staple food, usually rice) and ⟦{副食|ふくしょく}→副食：17154_fukushoku⟧ (everything else). {副食品|ふくしょくひん} is the formal term for these accompanying items.

JAPANESE MEAL STRUCTURE:
- ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧: staple food (rice, noodles, bread)
- ⟦{副食|ふくしょく}→副食：17154_fukushoku⟧/{副食品|ふくしょくひん}: side dishes (fish, meat, vegetables)
- ⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧: soup (miso soup, clear soup)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副食品|ふくしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase the variety of side dishes
- {副食品|ふくしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧: nutrition from side dishes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧: side dishes -- the everyday, casual term
- ⟦{副食|ふくしょく}→副食：17154_fukushoku⟧: side dishes -- slightly shorter form, same meaning
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧: prepared dishes -- ready-made side dishes sold at stores
